meta.name: video-dubbing
meta.description: Reference for the studio/dubbing service — the Kurdish Sorani to Iraqi Arabic video dubbing pipeline. Use this for any task involving audio/video processing, Demucs, transcription, translation prompts, TTS providers, or FFmpeg reassembly. Covers which TTS providers are licensed for client work and which are not.

copy.tagline: 快速获取库尔德语到阿拉伯语视频配音的完整流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在制作库尔德语到阿拉伯语的配音视频。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly learn the full pipeline for dubbing videos from Kurdish to Arabic.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are producing a dubbed video from Kurdish to Arabic.

howto.what: 作为配音服务参考,掌握库尔德索拉尼语→伊拉克阿拉伯语的视频配音流程:先用Demucs分离人声与背景,再用Gemini转写,经MiniMax翻译成伊拉克阿拉伯语,由TTS合成语音,最后用FFmpeg按原时间轴重组并混入保留的背景音。同时说明各TTS供应商(如MiniMax、Chatterbox、Fish Audio)是否允许用于客户项目。
howto.when: 当你提出涉及音视频处理、Demucs、转写、翻译提示、TTS供应商、FFmpeg重组,或库尔德索拉尼语译成伊拉克阿拉伯语配音等任务时触发。

say.text: 我要给一段库尔德语视频配上伊拉克阿拉伯语配音,该怎么做?
say.note: 它会给出完整五步流程及各步推荐工具。

say.text: 帮我用Demucs把这段视频的人声和背景音乐分开。
say.note: 触发步骤0,保留背景供后续混音。

say.text: 这项目能用Fish Audio做商业配音吗?
say.note: 它会说明Fish仅限研究用途,商业需另购许可。

howto.what_en: Acts as a reference for the studio dubbing service: the Kurdish Sorani to Iraqi Arabic video dubbing pipeline. It covers Demucs vocal/background separation, Gemini transcription, MiniMax translation, TTS synthesis, and FFmpeg reassembly, plus which TTS providers are licensed for client work.
howto.when_en: Triggered by any task involving audio/video processing, Demucs, transcription, translation prompts, TTS providers, FFmpeg reassembly, or the Kurdish Sorani to Iraqi Arabic dubbing pipeline.

say_en.text: I want to dub a Kurdish video into Iraqi Arabic. What's the process?
say_en.note: It will outline the five-step pipeline and recommended tools.

say_en.text: Use Demucs to split vocals from background music in this video.
say_en.note: Triggers step 0, preserving background for later remix.

say_en.text: Can I use Fish Audio commercially for this project?
say_en.note: It explains Fish is research-only unless a commercial license is bought.
